description.p: Vaulti is a password manager without a central server. Your devices sync directly with each other, and you can share collections of passwords with other people.

ul.li: End-to-end encrypted with your master password; recover with a backup code
Pair devices with a QR code and a confirmation code
Share collections with contacts as editor or viewer
Copied passwords are cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds

description.p: First release: local vault, device sync and collection sharing.
